---

Why combining models helps: ensemble risk equals average risk minus diversity; model averaging with weights; SuperLearner (stacking) with cross-validated predictions and a meta-learner. Bagging, random forests and boosting (Lecture 10) are the tree-based members of this family.

📖 **Assigned reading:** ISLR §8.2
